messages:
Sarah L: Quick sync — need to lock priority slices for the beta waitlist and decide feedback routing. 20m today?
Alex M: I'm in. Proposed slices: integrations, low-latency, privacy-regulated. Cap each at ~30 seats to start.
Priya K: I'd rather slice by workload: search/QA, summarization, embeddings-heavy. Routing idea: critical bugs -> oncall, UX feedback -> research queue.
Jamal B: Reserve 5 seats for enterprise security customers (Private/Dedicated). Need to confirm telemetry and KMS access for them.
Ben R: For gating, can we use a `priority_token` filter on signup? cc @ops-bot — that would simplify routing.
ops-bot: Deploy ticket created: DB-4578. ETA for gating flag: ~48 hours.
Ben R: Prototype routing rule (example):
```
route:
  if slice == 'latency' and tier == 'self-serve' -> model: small-llm
  else -> model: default
```
Priya K: For evals, recommend 3 prompt suites per slice + micro-survey. Baseline metrics: p50 latency, cost/token, hallucination rate. I'll draft prompt sets.
Alex M: Launch cadence suggestion: 10% initial invites -> 24h probe window -> expand based on quality signals. Keep rollbacks fast. :thumbsup:
Sarah L: Draft launch criteria (working): stable p50 <= 250ms for latency slice, <5% critical regressions, >=40% micro-survey response rate. Owners?
Jamal B: I'll own enterprise seats + compliance checklist (SOC/ISO items).
Priya K: I'll own prompt suites, micro-survey design, and eval dashboards.
Ben R: I'll own routing rules, automation, and a short rollback playbook.
Sarah L: Great — I'll update the playbook doc (draft): https://redwood.internal/docs/beta-waitlist-routing and schedule 11:20am PT sync. If anyone can't make it, drop async notes here.
Alex M: Adding a tiny TODO: capture expected RU and token budget per slice so capacity planning isn't an afterthought.
Priya K: Also: include an explicit consent checkbox for telemetry for enterprise seats (legal asked).
Sarah L: Noted. Thanks all — will post agenda and pre-read in 15.
